messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE -> P1: Elevated 5xx + high latency observed for Hosted API and Dedicated pools in ap-east-1. Pager: caroline (oncall-sre) has been paged. Links: https://redsight.internal/graphs?region=ap-east-1 :rotating_light:
caroline (oncall-sre): I'm on it. seeing a big jump in 5xx around 09:12 UTC. pulling logs now.
josh (platform): looking at control-plane and auth call graph — spikes correlate with AWS STS/KMS egress errors from ap-east-1. AWS status?
maria (infra): AWS console shows increased error rates for iam and kms in ap-east-1 region: "502/504" to downstream vendors. posting AWS Health link: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incident/ap-east-1
caroline (oncall-sre): Confirmed. Hosted API latency P95 gone from 120ms -> 900ms. Dedicated pools showing queue growth and token-latency.
alex (support): Any immediate customer impact? CS reporting multiple open tickets in AP region.
caroline (oncall-sre): Early estimate: ~8% of requests for ap-east-1 returning 5xx, mostly auth-related failures during key decrypt / assume-role. A few Enterprise Dedicated customers on pinned capacity saw elevated tail latency and some 502s.
josh (platform): Recommend immediate routing fallback for non-data-sensitive requests: policy -> prefer eu-west-1, fallback to hosted fallback pool. Will push rule to edge.
maria (infra): I can add edge routing rule now. Patch command: ```/infra deploy-routes --region ap-east-1 --fallback eu-west-1 --scope hosted,dedicated --reason "sts/kms egress spike"```
caroline (oncall-sre): Do that. Also enable aggressive retries with exponential backoff on auth clients for 5xx 502/504. Patch for client side: set MAX_RETRIES=6, BACKOFF_BASE_MS=200.
josh (platform): Rolling edge rule now — pushing canary 10% traffic to eu-west-1, then 50% if stable. Will monitor logs for auth failure vs routing mismatch.
sre-bot: Deploy started by josh at 09:21 UTC. Canary -> 10%. Logs: https://logs.internal/ap-east-1/canary/3456789012
caroline (oncall-sre): Noted. Also opened temporary circuit-breaker on Dedicated pools for long auth latency to protect GPU workers: reject > 3s auth latency with 429 to upstream callers.
veronica (product): Heads up: schedule brief status update for customers on status.redwood.ai. Alex, can you draft?
alex (support): On it. Draft: "We are investigating elevated errors and latency impacting some requests in ap-east-1. We've initiated routing failover and mitigations; updates to follow."
caroline (oncall-sre): Observability: prefix caching prevented larger tail in some services. KV cache hit rate stable at 88%. Good.
maria (infra): AWS health showing "Investigating" for STS/KMS in ap-east-1. Might be a third-party egress (our NATs) but correlation is strong for AWS dependency.
josh (platform): Canary stable for 15m — auth error rate on canary path down 70%. Increasing to 50% now.
sre-bot: Canary increased to 50% at 09:37 UTC.
caroline (oncall-sre): Good. Customer impact: updated estimate -> 3 primary customers reported errors (2 Enterprise Dedicated, 1 PLG). Routing/fallback should mitigate new requests; existing inflight may still error.
\alex (support): Posted status update: "Mitigations in place; routing to alternative region for some traffic. We're monitoring and will provide ETA."
veronica (product): Product note: for Dedicated customers, follow up with personalized communications and offer assistance with pinning fallback configs if needed.
caroline (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm staying for postmortem. Maria, please take on platform followups for routing rollback and metrics collection. Josh, please own deploy audit and canary logs. Alex/Veronica coordinate customer comms.
maria (infra): Ack. collecting graphs -> will attach perf and auth call traces.
josh (platform): Will compile deploy timeline and change diff.
sre-bot: Monitoring: 5xx rate in ap-east-1 down from ~8% to ~1.2% after routing. Latency p95 improving.
caroline (oncall-sre): Closing pager to incident channel; keep thread for followups. If AWS posts resolution, we'll plan postmortem with timeline, root cause (STS/KMS egress), and mitigation backlog (regional routing automation, improved Key-management retry/backoff). :white_check_mark:
